fields.name: ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable membership record and version mutation shape
fields.description: The membership mutation shape that ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable passes to its cluster membership query contract combines the addressed member state with the presented table-version and member-row concurrency state.

members.name: ClusterId
members.description: Cluster whose membership table is mutated or read.

members.name: Address
members.description: Network address bytes identifying the member.

members.name: Status
members.notes: Both the mutation path and the ReadRow/ReadAll reconstruction treat this value as smallint.

members.name: ETagNo
members.description: Numeric table etag supplied from the table version's ETag string; the write succeeds only if it equals the stored table etag, which the write advances by one.

members.name: MemberETagNo
members.description: Update only: the member row's own etag (UpdateRow's etag argument), which must equal the row's stored etag.

members.name: SuspectTimes
members.description: Suspect reports sent as a table-valued parameter, one row per distinct suspecting silo (Address, Port, Generation) carrying that suspector's latest report timestamp; each row has Address varbinary(150), Port int, Generation int, and Timestamp datetime2. Omitted (null) when there are no reports.

representations.CSharp: MembershipEntry supplies member state; TableVersion supplies Version and a string VersionEtag parsed as int; UpdateRow's etag string is parsed as int; suspect reports are materialized as SqlDataRecord values.
